title: Faces in Things, Faces in Nothing: Probing Face Selectivity in Vision Models with Pareidolia
abstract: arXiv:2603.03989v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: An electrical outlet can look like a face without depicting a person. Face pareidolia is thus a revealing probe of how vision models turn ambiguous visual evidence into category judgments. When a model calls such an object Human, does that answer depend on its face-like arrangement? Using the FacesInThings dataset, we test six vision models, from a vision-only ViT to CLIP and generative vision-language models, with face detectors as a reference. Each face-like region is paired with three controls from the same photograph that lack the arrangement: a background crop, the region with its tiles shuffled, and its average color. A Human answer driven by the arrangement should appear less often on these controls. We also vary how the categories are described. Three findings emerge. translated_title: 物中之脸，无中之脸：利用空想性错视探究视觉模型的人脸选择性
translated_abstract: 一个电源插座即使没有描绘任何人，也可能看起来像一张脸。因此，人脸空想性错视（face pareidolia）是探究视觉模型如何将模糊视觉证据转化为类别判断的一个有效探针。当模型将这类物体判定为“Human（人类）”时，这一判断是否依赖于其类脸的排列方式？我们利用 FacesInThings 数据集测试了六个视觉模型——从纯视觉的 ViT 到 CLIP 以及生成式视觉-语言模型，并以人脸检测器作为参照。每个类脸区域都与来自同一照片的三种缺乏该排列的对照条件配对：背景裁剪区域、将图块打乱后的区域，以及该区域的平均颜色。如果“Human”的回答是由排列方式驱动的，那么在这些对照条件上该回答出现的频率应当更低。我们还改变了类别的描述方式。研究得出了三项发现。首先，模型会对空想出的脸作出响应，但其方式与人类不同：人脸检测器很少在这些区域返回人脸结果，然而 CLIP ViT-L/14 和两个生成式（摘要在此处不完整，原文被截断）
tldr: 该论文以人脸空想性错视为探针，利用 FacesInThings 数据集和三种同照片对照条件测试六个视觉模型，发现模型虽然会对虚假人脸作出响应，但其判断机制与人类并不相同。
en_tdlr: Using the FacesInThings dataset with three same-photo controls, this paper probes face pareidolia in six vision models and finds that while models respond to illusory faces, they do so differently from humans.
